CHAPTER.VERS: LORD, I cry to thee: make haste to me; give ear to my voice, when I cry to thee.

Let my prayer be set forth before thee incense; the lifting up of my hands the evening sacrifice.
set…: Heb. directed
Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
Incline not my heart to evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

Let the righteous smite me; a kindness: and let him reprove me; an excellent oil, shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also in their calamities.
me; it shall be a…: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc
When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth upon the earth.

But my eyes to thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
leave…: Heb. make not my soul bare
Keep me from the traps they have laid for me, and the snares of the workers of iniquity.

Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I escape.
escape: Heb. pass over
